author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0001010 RNA polymerase II sequence-specific DNA-binding transcription factor recruiting activity, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31456

There are 2 BHF (done) and 6 SGD annotations to this term, see https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Vn1yXLkMwcsaroGh4TCqbTRpuyzLHitxBGIaYNYcxSA/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Suggestions have been made for re-annotation. 

Thanks, Pascale
title: Review annotations to GO:0001010 RNA polymerase II sequence-specific DNA-binding transcription factor recruiting activity

author: pgaudet
body:
Same for GO:0001139 RNA polymerase II complex recruiting activity
This has been replaced by [transcription coactivator activity](http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GO_0003713). 

All annotations are by SGD @edwong57 

Thanks, Pascale
